Just checking what other people are playing. I've tried:

Rank 4 at the moment, and I'm seeing a lot of Face Hunter that is taking advantage of the untuned nature of the new experiments. That's why I'm sticking mostly to Warrior/Priest for the moment.

Control Warrior seems pretty mediocre right now. Both Brawls are certainly necessary as the weapons just don't do enough.

Totem Shaman I had high hopes for, but every game feels really hard to win. The deck just lacks punch. And I can't find a good matchup at all.

Dragon Priest seems to be the real deal. The early game is great, the mid game is great, and the end game is great. The only weakness of the deck is that you probably have to keep ANY dragon in your opening hand as not getting one is really bad. That means Ysera and 2 random cards can lead to some quick defeats. But it's definitely not a deal breaker.
